notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ Request Attribute Value Update With Regions service to exact official declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. The implementation covers the class-level no-time solicitation path, committed region validation, overlap/default-region filtering, the standard Provide Attribute Value Update callback shape, and focused requester/provider filesystem report boundaries: the accepted requester records the type-36/type-4/type-63 §9.13 invocation before the eligible regional callback, while the provider records the type-37/type-1/type-63 callback immediately before user code. It also covers explicit provider responses through no-time and timestamped Update Attribute Values to region-aware Reflect Attribute Values, including TSO callback/grant ordering and source-region metadata, plus a callback-boundary suppression when the receiver's committed regional subscription becomes disjoint before delivery. It does not claim automatic provider responses, broader timestamped/retraction matrices, advisory scope transitions, relaxed DDM, save/restore, remote transport, package support, catalog evidence, or conformance.
